text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALES - Algeria has bought 100,000 tonnes of French soft wheat at a delivered price of $188 per tonne for Nov and Dec arrival. The deal, concluded on Wednesday, valued the wheat at some $160 per tonne fob, excluding all financing and other costs. The wheat was sold with Coface export credits. Algeria tendered on Monday for 50,000 tonnes to be delivered in the second half of November and 50,000 tonnes in the first half of December. Traders were invited to submit offers for both French and U.S. wheat.

WHEAT SALES (cont.) - Two Philippine flour mills bought 19,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat at $162 per tonne, traders said. The order, for November delivery, was clinched on Wednesday night by a Japanese commodity firm, one Manila trader said. Philippine traders said on Wednesday local flour mills have asked price quotations for a total 109,000 tonnes of combined U.S. dark northern spring wheat and western white wheat.
- Argentine exporters sold 50,000 tonnes of wheat to Algeria at $169 CIF for December to January delivery, Argentinian traders said.

WHEAT AND BARLEY SALE - The Japanese Food Agency said on Thursday it bought 60,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 57,600 of Canadian wheat and 40,000 of Australian wheat at its weekly tender, all for December shipment. It also bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. barley and 2,400 of Canadian barley.

SOYBEAN OIL SALE - China has bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. soybean oil for shipment on October 24, U.S. exporters said. One exporter noted there was also talk China could have made additional purchases, possibly bringing Thursday's total purchase to as much as 70,000 tonnes.

BARLEY TENDER - The Taiwan Barley Association will tender on Friday for either 26,000 or 32,000 tonnes U.S. barley, local traders said. The shipment would be slated for delivery from October 20 to November 10.
WHEAT TENDERS - Sri Lanka is to seek October 18 100,000 tonnes optional-origin wheat for Nov 11-20 shipment.

- Morocco will tender on Thursday for 40,000 tonnes optional soft wheat for delivery in first half of November, the Office Interprofessionnel des Cereales et Legumineuses said. The tender's closing date is Thursday.
MARKET TALK - A Turkish pasta producer is planning to import 15,000 tonnes of durum wheat from Syria to be delivered in November and December, traders said.

... Japan's Food Agency said it found stones in a shipment of U.S. barley and hinted it might shift to Canadian barley unless the problem was solved. The stones were found in barley that arrived in mid-September.
... Casualties are starting to mount as Chinese buyers of soybeans and soybean meal default or cancel contracts in the wake of alling international prices, Asian trading sources said.
